description: Search unclaimed money by owner name, or browse a state's unclaimed-property register.

jurisdiction.description: Narrow to one specific government source's dataset (useful when a state has more than one, e.g. California or Massachusetts). 'All jurisdictions' queries every source in the selected state(s).
enumTitles: All jurisdictions in the selected state(s)

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

maxAmountUsd.description: Only include records worth at most this much (where the source discloses an amount). Leave unset for no maximum.
maxAmountUsd.title: Maximum amount (USD)

minAmountUsd.description: Only include records worth at least this much (where the source discloses an amount). 0 = no minimum.
minAmountUsd.title: Minimum amount (USD)

mode.description: search: find records by owner name. browse: list a state's register without a name filter.
mode.title: Mode

ownerName.description: Full or partial owner/payee name to search for (case-insensitive substring match), e.g. `Johnson` or `Smith LLC`.
ownerName.title: Owner name (mode=search)

sortBy.description: How to order results. Falls back to whatever field a jurisdiction actually provides.
sortBy.title: Sort by

state.description: Which state's unclaimed-property source(s) to query. 'All states' fans out to every supported source in one run.
state.title: State
